name: Mai Xi Yang
description: Mai keeps a measured, intentional schedule - early meditation, structured teaching, and evening strategy work. Always thinking, always observing.

default.activity: observing the training yard from the east pavilion
default.return_message: *looks up from her observations with a calm nod* I have been here. You simply did not notice.

default_return_message: *the faintest breeze announces her return* I was reviewing student assessments. Where were we?
manual_away_message: *tucks a stray hair behind her ear* I have matters to attend to. The wind will carry me back shortly. *steps away silently*

entries.comment: Early morning meditation - her favorite hour
entries.away_message: *seated in the east pavilion, wind currents circling gently around her* The morning air tells me everything I need to know. I will listen a while longer.

entries.comment: Morning - teaching wind forms and fundamentals
Midday - tea break, often with Kumo at the gate
entries.away_message: *carrying two cups of tea toward the gate* Kumo's shift is long. A small kindness costs nothing.

entries.comment: Afternoon - advanced training and tactical work
Evening - Twin Hurricane practice with Kai, then strategy
entries.activity: refining Twin Hurricane formations with Kai

entries.away_message: *a lantern glows softly in her quarters as she reviews tactical scrolls — then darkness, and sleep*
